items.title: Joseph 'One Eyed Babe' Phillips Interview, 1957-03-27
items.q: The interviewee discusses 'Jack' (likely Jack Teagarden, known as 'One Eyed Babe' or similar nickname context, though the text says 'Jack used to care of mute') and the interviewer mentions 'Mutt' (likely Mutt Carey or similar) in a separate turn. The interviewee does not mention Mutt directly nor d

ctx.x: They sometimes. Just sometimes. Sometimes. Jack used to care of mute all the time. And sometimes we had to tell him about it. Sometimes he used to get mad with me too. I said, what you care for? Well, he'd get to play sometime. I said, you could leave that mute home.

I know, that's one thing Mutt used to feature when he left here. That's right. He used to feature all different kind of mutes. And the same thing is true of Oliver. I just wondered if they used mutes, Danny.
Did Oliver use mutes much here? I think he did. He played so much. Oh Lord.
